fastrr × WishCare — a proposal for Stuti and Ankit Kothari

You already trust Shiprocket with your parcels. Let your checkout see what we see.

WishCare ships with Shiprocket and checks out with GoKwik. That means the company that knows what happens to your orders after they leave is not the one running the checkout. This proposal shows what changes when both sit on one network, across the whole journey from the first ad to the reorder, and proposes a simple way to let your own numbers decide: a side-by-side A/B test.

The Clear Differentiator

The network that ships your orders can also run your checkout. That is the difference.

Most checkouts are built on payment data. They see the click, the cart and the payment, then the order leaves their sight. fastrr is built on Shiprocket's delivery network, and WishCare's parcels already travel on it.

1

A delivery promise from the network that will keep it

The date on your product page comes from live courier performance across the same Shiprocket network that carries your parcels, so the promise at checkout matches what happens at the doorstep.

2

Risk judged on what actually happened

COD and RTO risk is scored from 620M+ real delivery outcomes, including refusals and failed deliveries, before the order ships. Payment data alone cannot see those.

3

Addresses proven by delivery

Pre-fill comes from addresses that were actually delivered across a network of 400M+ consumers, at 98% accuracy, so fewer parcels fail on a wrong address.

4

One loop, from ad to reorder

The same data powers ads, product page, cart, checkout and messaging. 8B data points mean each step learns from the others, instead of each tool working alone.

The difference in one line

"A suite built on payment data can tell you a transaction succeeded. Only one built on top of an actual delivery network can tell you, before the order ships, whether it is coming back."

Where WishCare Stands Today

A science-led brand with a clear promise. The checkout should carry that promise to the doorstep.

On the pages we reviewed, WishCare offers 5% extra off on prepaid orders, free delivery above ₹399, a Buy 2 at ₹799 offer, tiered discounts for one, two or three items, and routine bundles. Shoppers are drawn to ingredient-led products, such as the Hair Growth Serum Concentrate with 1,200+ reviews. A range built around routines and bundles rewards a smart cart, an accurate delivery date and a safety net for first-time buyers.

What stands out on the pages we reviewed

  • Many offers at once. Prepaid discount, free delivery, Buy 2, tiers and bundles, all competing for attention.
  • No delivery date on the product page. A shopper only learns when it arrives late in the journey.
  • Routines and bundles. A natural fit for guided add-ons in the cart.
  • COD available. Which brings return risk, even with a prepaid discount.

What fastrr adds on top

  • One best offer surfaced on the product page, with the prepaid saving highlighted.
  • A delivery date with the pincode pre-filled, from the same network that ships the order.
  • AI-guided routines in the cart, opened in place, toward your free-delivery and bundle tiers.
  • Pay After Delivery and risk tagging, so COD stops being a gamble.
Stage 1 · Discover and recognise

Find the right shopper, and know her when she comes back.

A shopper sees an ad for a hair or sunscreen product, taps through, reads a few pages and leaves without logging in. Like most paid visitors, she is gone, and so is the money spent on the click.
fastrr Ads & Studio

Creative is the new targeting

Meta's AI picks the audience. Your creative tells it who to find: a hairfall-concern creative finds a different shopper from a sun-protection creative.

  • Know which creative makes money. ROAS by hook, story and visual style.
  • Read competitors' playbooks. Spend, format mix and strategy shifts.
  • Create in seconds. 200,000+ real ads as reference, no designer needed.
  • Launch 4 ads or 400. Bulk launch with AI-written copy.
fastrr Signals

Better signals mean better buyers

100+ audience signals from real purchase behaviour, with category signals such as health and beauty, value signals for order value and frequency, and delivery signals for RTO band and prepaid propensity, plus a clean event layer so Meta sees the sales it was missing.

fastrr Identify

Up to 40% of anonymous users, identified

About 95% of paid visitors leave without a name. Because of the ecosystem, up to 40% of anonymous users on the platform can be identified, so a large share of invisible visits becomes customers you can reach.

fastrr Connect

WhatsApp that remembers what she looked at

A reminder tied to the exact product she viewed, with her delivery date, that brings her back to the page. A dedicated strategy manager plans it with your team.

What it brings WishCare
  • Ads that find buyers who keep their orders, not only those who click
  • 5.9x vs 1.05x ROAS in a fastrr example with the same budget and targeting, where only the hook and CTA changed
  • 20x ROAS on re-engaged anonymous shoppers, in fastrr's own results

Stage 2 · The product page

She lands on the product. Three questions come up before she adds it.

Skincare and haircare are bought with a routine in mind. Before she adds a serum she wants to know when it arrives, what the best price is among your several offers, and whether she can trust a first order. She may also have a question about the product itself.
Dynamic EDD

A delivery date, with her pincode already filled in

The widget shows an estimated delivery date for her pincode, pre-filled from the last delivered address on the network. 96%+ accurate, predicted from live courier data, from the same network that ships your orders.

SDD / NDD

Same-day and next-day, where they apply

For eligible pincodes the page offers "Get it today" and "Get it tomorrow", powered by Shiprocket's own network.

PDP discount widget

The single best offer, shown upfront

With 5% off prepaid, free delivery above ₹399, Buy 2 and tiered offers all live, shoppers have a lot to decode. The widget surfaces the best applicable offer beside Add to Cart, with prepaid and bank offers highlighted.

Pay After Delivery widget

A safety net, on the page

A first-time buyer sees that she can pay after the parcel arrives, which removes the biggest hesitation for a newer brand.

fastrr Assist

A sales manager on the website

An AI assistant greets the shopper, asks what she needs, shows the right product, answers questions on delivery and use, and adds to cart in the chat. It answers in about 3 seconds, 24x7, only within the guidance WishCare approves.

Stage 4 · The checkout

One page. Nothing to type. Her address and her date are already there.

She taps Checkout. Anyone the network recognises sees her address filled in, her delivery date confirmed and her preferred payment ready.
fastrr Checkout — live on Innovist, a skincare brand, with address pre-fill, EDD, offers and Quick Pay
Address pre-fill

98% address accuracy, nothing to type

The address comes from the network, already verified by real deliveries, so even a first-time WishCare shopper may arrive with her address filled in.

Accurate EDD on checkout

The date, once more, at the moment of payment

The same predicted date she saw on the product page, so the promise holds all the way through.

SSO and Quick Pay

One-tap login, one-tap payment

SSO-powered acceleration (65%) lets returning shoppers skip OTPs, address entry and payment selection, and Quick Pay pins her preferred UPI app as one tap. Useful for a replenishment product.

Bank offers and payment personalisation

The right offer and mode, per shopper

Upsell on checkout

A final relevant suggestion on the checkout page itself, such as a lip balm or a travel size, added without leaving it.

What it brings WishCare
  • Faster checkouts, with fewer drop-offs at the address form
  • Fewer failed deliveries from mistyped addresses
  • 17% higher conversion on a live fashion brand, Rare Rabbit
Stage 5 · How she pays

She picks how to pay. WishCare stays protected either way.

You already give 5% off to prepaid orders, which shows you care about the payment mix. Some shoppers still pick COD, and some are new and unsure. The checkout gives each the right option, and tells you which COD orders are likely to come back before they ship.
Pay After Delivery

For high-risk and hesitant shoppers

The risk engine flags COD shoppers who are likely to refuse. Instead of plain COD, they are offered Pay After Delivery: a UPI mandate is approved at checkout, the amount is held and not debited, and it is charged once the parcel is delivered.

  • Genuine buyers convert with nothing paid upfront
  • Impulse and fake orders drop off
  • No cash to collect at the door
RTO risk tagging

Know the risk before you ship

Every COD order is tagged using address, pincode and buyer history across the network. You choose between risk prediction and specific tags, such as high-refusal pincodes or first-time buyers.

Custom rule engine

Your rules, A/B tested

Combine risk, cart value and shopper into your own rules, then split-test them to see which wins on conversion and RTO.

Multiple gateways and smart switching

Choose the gateway, and let fastrr route to the best one

fastrr works with PayU, Easebuzz, BillDesk and PhonePe. Smart gateway auto-switching routes each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time, so fewer payments fail in high-traffic sale hours.

What it brings WishCare
  • Up to 30% RTO reduction with risk tagging
  • Prepaid share up from 80% to 92% on Fixderma, a skincare brand, using Quick Pay
  • Payment abandonment down from 28% to 19% with AI-suggested payment modes

The order ships on Shiprocket. fastrr Connect keeps the conversation going, and 8B data points help you know who is buying.

Skincare and haircare are bought again when the bottle runs out. A reminder at the right time brings a customer back, and what you learn about her makes every step before it smarter.

Strategy manager

Today vs. fastrr

GoKwik does a lot well. Here is where a delivery network changes the picture.

This is not a case that GoKwik does not work. Its public listing covers smart login, address prefill, COD blocking, upsells and cart recovery. The difference is where the data comes from: a checkout built on payment data, or one built on the delivery network that also ships your order.

Checkpointfastrr (Shiprocket)GoKwik, from its public listing

Address pre-fill✓ 98% accuracy, built on addresses actually delivered, 400M+ consumers~ Address prefill and validation, listed without an accuracy figure
Delivery date (EDD)✓ On the product page, cart and checkout, from live courier data, 96%+ accurate; plus SDD/NDD~ Shipping options are listed; a delivery date is not described

The proposal · A/B test

Testing is how every other part of your business gets decided. Checkout should be no different.

You test ad creatives, offers, landing pages and subject lines, because assuming is expensive. Checkout is where every rupee of that spend either converts or leaks, and it is the part least often tested. We are not asking you to switch. We are asking to let your own numbers decide.

Why this is business hygiene

What good operators already do

  • Nothing is assumed. A vendor's claims, and ours, are checked against your own traffic.
  • The market keeps moving. Checkout, payments and delivery tools change every quarter. A periodic test tells you where you stand.
  • Leverage. Knowing how two options perform on your numbers makes every vendor conversation better, ours included.
  • Low risk. Only a share of traffic sees the test, and it can be moved back at any time.
How the test is run

Agreed upfront, so there are no surprises

  • Same conditions. Same products, offers and traffic sources, so only the checkout differs.
  • A clear split and duration, agreed before launch.
  • A decision rule, agreed before launch: which metrics matter and what counts as a win.
  • Shared numbers. Both of you see the same scorecard, from your own analytics and orders.
The proof

Innovist and Dermatouch ran this test first

Innovist and Dermatouch both A/B tested their checkout journeys against what they had, on their own traffic. After seeing their own numbers, they moved ahead with fastrr by Shiprocket and shifted their traffic to it. They did not take our word for it, and neither should you.
